title: Email Marketing for Real Estate: Emails, Sequences and Setup for India
seoTitle: Email Marketing for Real Estate: Emails, Setup, Rules
excerpt: Email marketing for real estate in India: the emails to send, a follow-up sequence, subject lines, DPDP consent, SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup, tools and metrics.

faqs.question: Does email marketing work for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: Yes, as a follow-up channel. WhatsApp gets the first reply, but email carries the detail buyers save and forward, such as brochures, price sheets, payment plans and construction updates. That keeps long buying decisions warm and suits NRI buyers in other time zones.

faqs.question: What emails should a real estate business send?
faqs.answer: An enquiry follow-up with the brochure, site-visit confirmations and reminders, an after-visit email with the price sheet, monthly construction updates, new launch emails to past buyers who opted in, and payment and possession updates for existing buyers. Each email should have one main action.

faqs.question: What is a good real estate email follow-up sequence?
faqs.answer: Send the brochure and visit link within minutes, answers to common worries on day 2, a walkthrough video on day 5, a locality guide on day 9, and a 'should I keep your enquiry open?' email on day 14. Then send monthly updates. Stop when the buyer replies.

faqs.question: How do I stop my real estate emails going to spam?
faqs.answer: Send from your own domain, set up SPF, DKIM and DMARC, add a visible unsubscribe link with one-click unsubscribe, and keep spam complaints low. Google asks bulk senders to stay below a 0.30% spam rate, ideally below 0.10%. Remove bounced addresses after every send.

faqs.question: Can I buy an email list of property buyers?
faqs.answer: No. Bought lists damage your sender reputation and conflict with India's DPDP Act, 2023, which centres on consent for a clear purpose. Only email people who gave you their address through a form, site visit register or purchase, and who expect to hear from you.

faqs.question: What does India's DPDP Act mean for email marketing?
faqs.answer: The DPDP Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules notified in November 2025 require a clear consent notice explaining why data is used, let people withdraw consent at any time, and give businesses an eighteen-month phased compliance period. Record consent and honour unsubscribe requests quickly.

faqs.question: What makes a good real estate email subject line?
faqs.answer: Specific and plain, such as 'Tower B slab work done: October photos' or 'Your site visit on Saturday at 11 am: map and parking'. Say exactly what is inside. Avoid all caps, 'URGENT' and pushy offers, which hurt trust and can trigger spam filters.

faqs.question: What should I measure in real estate email marketing?
faqs.answer: Clicks, replies, site visits booked from email, bounces, unsubscribes and spam complaints. Open rates are less reliable because Apple's Mail Privacy Protection loads email content in the background, which can count an email as opened even when nobody read it.
